    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    parents = list(map(int, input[1:]))

    # Initialize the tree structure
    tree = defaultdict(list)
    colors = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))
    max_colors = [0] * (n + 2)

    def find_min_color(node):
        used_colors = set(colors[node].values())
        color = 1
        while color in used_colors:
            color += 1
        return color

    result = []

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        parent = parents[i - 1]
        tree[parent].append(i + 1)

        min_color = find_min_color(parent)
        colors[parent][i + 1] = min_color
        colors[i + 1][parent] = min_color

        max_colors[i + 1] = max(max_colors[parent], min_color)
        max_colors[parent] = max(max_colors[parent], min_color)

        result.append(max_colors[i + 1])

    print(" ".join(map(str, result)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
